title: LADM Submission Package
description: A self-contained change package submitted to the cadastral system. Bundles all objects involved in one cadastral transaction: sources (spatial and/or administrative), new spatial features, parties, BAUnits, and RRRs. Voids are declared inside each source's 'voidedObjects'. New objects use client-generated UUIDs — the cadastral system replaces these with persistent identifiers after acceptance.

submissionId.description: Unique identifier for this submission, assigned by the submitter's software

submittedBy.description: Contact details of the party submitting this package (surveyor, notary, or their software)

description.description: Human-readable description of the transaction (e.g. 'Parcel split 1234/5 into 1234/6 and 1234/7')

sources.description: Source objects driving this transaction. Must include at least one LA_SpatialSource or LA_AdministrativeSource. Each source declares its own createdObjects and voidedObjects.

spatialFeatures.description: JSON-FG FeatureCollection of all spatial features created or modified in this transaction (LA_SpatialUnit, LA_Point, LA_SpatialUnitGroup). coordRefSys is required at collection level.

parties.description: Party objects created in this transaction (new owners, buyers, etc.). Existing parties are referenced by FeatureRef inside RRRs.

baUnits.description: Basic Administrative Units created in this transaction

rrrs.description: Rights, Restrictions, and Responsibilities created in this transaction
